# HyperOS Launcher Mod Lite **A lighter build of the HyperOS Launcher Mod, made for low-end devices.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Optimised app-open animations - Custom grid sizes - Choose the widget provider - Hide apps - Stacked recents - Widget support and performance tweaks from the main mod ## Requirements - HyperOS - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. ## Screenshots

HyperOS Launcher Mod Lite

A lighter build of the HyperOS Launcher Mod, made for low-end devices.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Optimised app-open animations
  • Custom grid sizes
  • Choose the widget provider
  • Hide apps
  • Stacked recents
  • Widget support and performance tweaks from the main mod

    • Requirements

  • HyperOS
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/HyperOS-launcher-mod-lite/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
